findings.title: Audit subject not frozen; branch amended mid-audit
findings.body: HEAD moved from b0ea0b03d (03:48:09) to 16a14779b (03:52:06) during the audit. Task statement, HEAD_SHA.txt, DIFF.patch, STAT.txt and VALIDATION_RECEIPTS.json still describe b0ea0b03d. Packet S2 requires a frozen subject. Re-freeze on one SHA and regenerate bundle and receipts.

findings.title: Four docs fail docs_frontmatter_guard on designated head b0ea0b03d
findings.body: Guard reports 'Needs update 4 file(s)' (missing author/date/prelude) on backend-runner-contract, current-runtime-reconciliation, runner-capability-matrix, series-lineage. Resolved only in 16a14779b, where the guard passes; still failing on the designated head.

findings.title: git diff --check fails on live tip 16a14779b
findings.body: tests/unit/dcp/test_runner_capability_registry.py:140: new blank line at EOF (rc=2). Packet-mandated verify step. Absent on b0ea0b03d. One-line fix.

findings.title: Review bundle stale; AGY prompt cites nonexistent head SHA
findings.body: Bundle describes b0ea0b03d not the tip. AGY_AUDIT_PROMPT.txt names b0ea0b03d5fa6667a42ec1b89793774880c54172, which does not exist (git cat-file fails) and matches neither SHA. DIFF.patch and GIT_DIFF.patch are identical.

findings.title: uv.lock dirt is a non-frozen uv run side effect; verify command needs --extra test
findings.body: uv run in a clean detached worktree of b0ea0b03d modified uv.lock (+27 lines: pypdf, python-magic, tiktoken); not in either commit. Do not stage. Plain 'uv run pytest' fails in a fresh venv (pytest is in the test extra); I used 'uv run --extra test pytest tests/unit/dcp -q'. Receipts recorded the plain command as passing.

findings.title: Host-specific absolute paths in runner_capabilities.json at designated head
findings.body: b0ea0b03d commits /Users/hue/... paths and local CLI versions; tip normalises to ~/... Non-authoritative inventory, all authorization flags false; no safety impact.

findings.title: Thin capability-registry tests at designated head
findings.body: b0ea0b03d lacks tests for true global_* flags and for authorized_runners() raising on mutated state; tip adds both.

findings.title: current-runtime-reconciliation.md cites post-#1400 main
findings.body: origin/main is f9ea7d1af (#1401, CI-only). Harmless but inexact. External-state claims (PAL, OpenCode, LiteLLM, GitHub control plane) were not verified.

findings.title: Manifest entries have self-only producer/consumer
findings.body: DCP_RUNNER_CONTRACT lists runner_contract.py as producer and consumer; DCP_RUNNER_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY has no producer. Consistent with an inert contract; REPO_CROSS_CHECKED rests on test-level schema validation.
